name: Clothes steamer

lead: A clothes steamer is a handheld or upright appliance that heats water and sends steam onto hanging garments to relax wrinkles.
It is used as a faster, gentler alternative to ironing, especially for delicate fabrics. No clinical literature applies; its value is practical grooming.

paras: Hot steam relaxes fibre bonds so the fabric falls smoothly and sets as it dries.
Steam can burn, and hard water can clog units, so distilled water and descaling help. It is less effective for sharp creases on dense cotton. The benefit is temporary.
